entry_state: Policies depend on actual observable messages and remembered actions, not internal source identities. Unresolved timing can be kept exactly through complete disjoint splits with strict complements. A saved frontier must retain every pending cell, including possibly empty cells, until the whole domain is classified.
exit_state: Resumed search adds constraints on a fixed policy domain. Renaming preserves rules; a genuine refinement permits old rules to be lifted, while extra assignments need reached-action comparison. Source corrections across two decisions share one clock history, so marginally possible views cannot be combined independently.

observations.finding: Saved search verifies original domains, complete children, witnesses and contradictions. Step allowance and total cap have distinct meanings. A fixed original-registry message domain makes C[t+1] a subset of C[t] as established histories accumulate. Counterexample infeasibility can precede full search; positive feasibility cannot.
observations.disposition: retain the monotonicity argument and distinct explanatory scope of comparison counts; no durable-store implementation is claimed

observations.disposition: retain the explicit surjectivity and refusal-correspondence premises of17.35, and reached-action comparisons

observations.finding: One correction time admits coarse/coarse, refined/coarse and refined/refined views but excludes coarse/refined. Decision cutoffs differ while source clocks remain shared. observations.disposition: retain joint-versus-marginal counterexample and distinction between stage mapping, information feasibility and financial feasibility
